mapper.select: select FLOWID,FLOWNAME from PE_FLOW where OperateState <> 'D' order by SORT

select p.FLOWNAME as PROCESSNAME,p.SORT as PROCESSSORT,w.FLOWCOUNT,w.MINSORT,c.FLOWID,c.FLOWNAME,c.URL,c.WARNDAYS, c.SORT,c.WARNUPFLOWID,userflow.ACCOMPLISHTIME, warnflow.ACCOMPLISHTIME as BEGINTIME, (sysdate()-warnflow.ACCOMPLISHTIME) as ACCOMPLISHTDAYS, nowFlow.SORT as NOWSORT, nextFlow.SORT as NEXTSORT, (select max(sort) from PE_FLOW where PARENTID is not null) as MAXSORT from PE_FLOW p left join PE_FLOW c on p.FLOWID=c.PARENTID left join PE_JOINUSER_FLOW userflow on c.FLOWID=userflow.FLOWID and userflow.JOINUSERID=#{joinUserId} and userflow.OPERATESTATE <> 'D' -- 用户环节填写记录 left join (select p.FLOWID,count(1) as FLOWCOUNT,min(c.SORT) as MINSORT from PE_FLOW p left join PE_FLOW c on p.FLOWID=c.PARENTID where p.PARENTID is null group by p.FLOWID ) w on p.FLOWID=w.FLOWID -- 统计子节点数量 left join ( select wjf.JOINUSERID, max(wf.SORT) as SORT from PE_JOINUSER_FLOW wjf inner join PE_FLOW wf on wjf.FLOWID=wf.FLOWID inner join PE_FLOW p on wf.PARENTID=p.FLOWID where wjf.JOINUSERID=#{joinUserId} and wjf.OPERATESTATE <> 'D' group by wjf.JOINUSERID ) nowFlow on userflow.JOINUSERID=nowFlow.JOINUSERID -- 用户当前填写环节 left join ( select nextFlow.SORT,flow.FLOWID,flow.WARNUPFLOWID,flow.WARNDAYS from ( select min(f.SORT) SORT from PE_FLOW f left join PE_JOINUSER_FLOW uf on f.FLOWID=uf.FLOWID and uf.JOINUSERID=#{joinUserId} where uf.ID is null and f.PARENTID is not null ) nextFlow inner join PE_FLOW flow on nextFlow.SORT=flow.SORT and flow.PARENTID is not null ) nextFlow on c.FLOWID=nextFlow.FLOWID -- 用户下一待填写环节 left join PE_JOINUSER_FLOW warnflow on nextFlow.WARNUPFLOWID=warnflow.FLOWID and warnflow.JOINUSERID=#{joinUserId} and warnflow.OPERATESTATE <> 'D' -- 待填写环节的设置的预警环节填写记录 where p.PARENTID is null order by p.SORT,c.SORT

mapper.select:
select u.JOINUSERID,u.USERCODE,u.IDCARD,createuser.XM,z.DZZDM,z.DZZMC, apply.JOINTIME,recommend.CONFIRMTIME as RECOMMENDCONFIRMTIME,confir.CONFIRMTIME,u.CREATETIME from PE_JOINUSER u left join VM_RYJBXX_ALL us on u.USERCODE=us.RYBM left join PE_JOINAPPLY apply on u.JOINUSERID = apply.JOINUSERID left join VM_RYJBXX createuser on apply.CREATEUSERID = createuser.RYBM left join ZZ_ZZQKXX z on createuser.SZDZBDM=z.DZZDM left join PE_Recommend recommend on u.JOINUSERID = recommend.JOINUSERID left join PE_CONFIRMUSER confir on u.JOINUSERID = confir.JOINUSERID where us.RYBM is null
and z.DZZDM like concat('%',#{partyCode},'%')
and u.NAME like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and apply.JOINTIME >= date_forma(#{startDate},'yyyyMMdd')
and apply.JOINTIME < (date_forma(#{endDate},'yyyyMMdd')+1)
order by u.CREATETIME
